stories.title: Army awards Anduril contract worth up to $1.8B over five years to expand NGC2
stories.why: The contract marks the latest signal for the Army’s expansion of NGC2, an ecosystem of interconnected hardware and software underpinned by Anduril’s Lattice...

stories.title: Air Force Research Laboratory permanently deletes $10B vehicle
stories.why: The lab decides instead that its industry partnerships "are best served by using flexible, agile, and immediately available acquisition pathways.”

stories.title: DHS kicks its network, cloud and cyber consolidation vehicle down the road
stories.why: Industry will have an undetermined amount of extra time to gear up for this contract to centralize IT operations across the entire Homeland Security Department.

stories.title: FBI removes Accenture contractor after missed security patch led to breach
stories.why: The bureau’s cyber chief blamed a contractor’s failure to apply an available fix for an intrusion that may have exposed sensitive employee information.

stories.title: SAIC Closes Acquisition of Information Security Corp.
stories.why: SAIC has completed its acquisition of ISC, a developer of encryption software, to expand its zero trust and PQC capabilities.

stories.title: Leidos, Altaris Complete Analogic Security Screening Joint Venture
stories.why: Leidos will retain a significant minority stake while pursuing airport and air traffic systems modernization work.

stories.title: GSA overcomes protests to award contract for next gen HSPD-12 services
stories.why: GSA awarded XTec a $237.6 million contract to move the Personal Identity Verification credentialing service program into a new era.

stories.title: Pentagon picks 4 vendors for counter-drone directed energy pilot program
stories.why: AeroVironment, Epirus, Kord and Boeing were selected for JIATF-401’s pilot program.
